query: textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
  ) AS relevance
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
  plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
ORDER BY relevance DESC
LIMIT 100

query: amr parsing with an incremental joint model, junsheng zhou
sql:

  p.title,
  p.abstract,

    OR p.title ILIKE '%incremental joint model%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%amr%'

     ELSE 0

  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST

query: generative event schema induction with entity disambiguation
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%generative%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%generative%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%event schema%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%event schema%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%event schema induction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%event schema induction%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%schema induction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%schema induction%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%event%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%event%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%entity disambiguation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity disambiguation%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%entity linking%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity linking%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%generative event schema induction%' THEN 5
     WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%generative event schema induction%' THEN 4
     WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%event schema induction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%event schema induction%') THEN 3
     WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%event schema%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%event schema%') THEN 2
     WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%entity disambiguation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity disambiguation%' OR
           p.title ILIKE '%entity linking%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity linking%') THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: naacl, eduardo blanco, automatic generation and scoring of positive interpretations from negated statements
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%NAACL%'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%eduardo blanco%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%automatic generation%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%positive interpretation%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%positive interpretations%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%negated statement%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%negated statements%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%automatic generation%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%positive interpretation%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%positive interpretations%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%negated statement%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%negated statements%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%automatic generation and scoring of positive interpretations from negated statements%' THEN 3
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%automatic generation%' AND p.title ILIKE '%positive interpretation%' AND p.title ILIKE '%negated%' THEN 2
     ELSE 1
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.abstract,

ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'robust stochastic bandit algorithm adversarial')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

  p.title,
  p.abstract,

query: dartmouth college, enhanced twitter sentiment classification using contextual information
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON pa.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%enhanced%' AND p.title ILIKE '%twitter%' AND p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' AND p.title ILIKE '%context%')
    OR (p.abstract ILIKE '%enhanced%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%twitter%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%context%')
  )
  OR (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%dartmouth%'
    OR i.display_name ILIKE '%dartmouth college%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%enhanced twitter sentiment classification using contextual information%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%enhanced twitter sentiment classification using contextual information%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%twitter%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%twitter%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%dartmouth%' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%dartmouth college%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: a hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%review%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%review%')
    AND (
      p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect%'
      OR p.title ILIKE '%aspect-based%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect-based%'
      OR p.title ILIKE '%aspect based%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect based%'
    )
    AND (
      p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%'
      OR p.title ILIKE '%opinion%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%opinion%'
    )
  )
  OR (
    p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%aspect-based%' OR p.title ILIKE '%aspect based%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect-based%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect based%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100
